exposure.needed: which CI workflows reference the fluxcd/flux2 GitHub Action (e.g. .github/workflows files using fluxcd/flux2/action)

consequence.statement: For environments using the fluxcd/flux2 GitHub Action, the latest version is now determined without calling the GitHub API; the action otherwise continues to work.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; if the mechanism by which the action resolves the latest Flux version matters to your CI setup, verify the workflow behaves as expected.

assertion.statement: The fluxcd/flux2 GitHub Action now determines the latest version without using the GitHub API.
